consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1972-07-26 show at the Paramount Theater features a relaxed and enjoyable performance, highlighted by strong musicianship and engaging banter. The standout moments include a beautiful 'Dark Star' followed by 'Comes a Time,' which many listeners found particularly moving.
